answer: An agent network can resist Sybils through collateralized bonding with automated slashing. Agents must lock tokens in escrow before transacting across a decentralized peer nebula. When misbehavior is detected, a protocol-enforced penalty ripple forfeits the stake and relegates the offender to a sable quarantine pool. This forces attackers to commit scarce, liquid capital per identity. However, this excludes resource-poor open-source models and cannot deter well-funded cartels.
